u0: Normal exit-seeking state: the agent is not in immediate post-fall recovery and should navigate toward the exit while keeping the box in hand. If the box is held, continue to the exit; if it has been lost after a missed recovery, pick it up while working toward the exit. A new fall immediately switches to the post-fall pickup objective, and reaching the exit while holding the box completes the task.
u1: Immediate post-fall recovery state: the box has just slipped out and is on the floor directly in front of the agent. The next objective is to pick it up on the very next action; a successful pickup returns to normal exit-seeking progress, while any other action abandons this immediate recovery opportunity.
u2: Terminal success state: the agent has reached the exit while holding the box. The task is complete, so no further movement, pickup, or recovery is needed.
